label: Vega 60G analog/BRI VoIP gateway
description: Compact standalone analog VoIP gateway available with 2, 4 or 8 RJ-11 FXS ports (also 4/8 FXO, 4 FXO + 4 FXS, or 2/4 BRI variants), connected to the LAN by a single 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45 port.
notes: Datasheet LAN interfaces: 1 x RJ-45 gigabit Ethernet 1000BaseT. Port mix is an ordering option - 2/4/8 FXS, 4/8 FXO, 4 FXO + 4 FXS, or 2 BRI (4 calls) / 4 BRI (8 calls) with each BRI interface configurable as network or terminal side. This spec models the FXS variant (up to 8 analog ports); the analog and BRI ports are not Ethernet interfaces. Managed via web GUI, no local CLI. Sangoma knowledge base notes only the 4- and 8-FXS variants had shipped at time of writing.
